note: M6 AC 33/39: every RELEASED version, newest LAST, as {"versionName": "1.0.1", "versionCode": 20101, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "size": <APK bytes>, "sha256": "<64 lower-case hex>"}. A new release code must be greater than all of these and than minCode. 0.2.0 (20000, round-1 key, retired) was never released; minCode keeps codes above it. The Worker bundles this file: the last entry is /android/latest.json and the /android page (src/worker/src/android.ts); its APK must be uploaded to the R2 bucket howtogo-dl as howtogo-<versionName>.apk before deploying.
